site: Shiv Shakti Point — Chandrayaan-3 landing site
citation: NASA LRO LOLA polar GDR, south of 60 S, 60 m/px
grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 98 deg
resolution_note: source product is 60 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 68 x 34 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
note: Uneven mare-highland regolith; the traverse is over undulating regolith rather than a named grade.
